description: Utility and conversion functions for compatibility with the nghttp2 API within the HTTP/2 adapter namespace, including error code mappings, pointer conversions, and header structure generation.

methods.name: MakeCallbacksPtr
methods.description: Creates a unique_ptr for nghttp2_session_callbacks with a custom deleter.

methods.name: MakeSessionPtr
methods.description: Creates a unique_ptr for nghttp2_session with a custom deleter.

methods.name: ToUint8Ptr
methods.description: Converts a C-style string to a uint8_t pointer.

methods.name: ToStringView
methods.description: Converts nghttp2_rcbuf or byte pointers to absl::string_view.

methods.name: GetNghttp2Nvs
methods.description: Generates nghttp2_nv header vectors from a span of headers.

methods.name: GetResponseNghttp2Nvs
methods.description: Generates nghttp2_nv header vectors for a response, including :status pseudoheader.

methods.name: ToHttp2ErrorCode
methods.description: Maps a wire error code to an Http2ErrorCode enum.

methods.name: ToNgHttp2ErrorCode
methods.description: Converts an InvalidFrameError to its integer nghttp2 error code.

methods.name: ToInvalidFrameError
methods.description: Converts an integer error code to an InvalidFrameError enum.

methods.name: MakeZeroCopyDataFrameSource
methods.description: Transforms a nghttp2_data_provider into a DataFrameSource object.

methods.name: LogBeforeSend
methods.description: Logs a frame before it is sent.
